news.headline: Diesel price nose-dives by Rs32.63, petrol registers Rs2.97 increase
news.summary: Effective Aug 20, 2026, per a government Petroleum Division notification reported by Dawn.com: petrol up Rs2.97/litre to Rs337.51/litre; High-Speed Diesel (HSD) down Rs32.63/litre to Rs363.06/litre (from Rs395.69/litre) - an approximately 8.2% single-move cut. Tax component: Rs114/litre on petrol, Rs100/litre on diesel. The Petroleum Minister had previously said prices would now be set on a daily basis (rather than the earlier weekly/fortnightly cycle) due to international-price volatility from geopolitical tensions. Logged as impact 4 (sharp commodity/FX-linked price move, per desk criteria Rule 10) given the unusually large single-day diesel price swing with broad transport/logistics/inflation read-through; escalation flagged.

news.headline: Aurangzeb seeks $10bn US Exchange Stabilisation Support Facility, decision expected September
news.summary: Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb formally requested a $10bn Exchange Stabilisation Support Facility from the United States (raised with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent in Washington), aimed at strengthening FX reserves and rupee stability rather than functioning as a conventional loan. Negotiations continuing with US EXIM Bank and DFC; Aurangzeb says a decision/breakthrough is expected by September 2026. Not yet approved - a pending request, no confirmed facility or drawdown. Logged as impact 3 (notable macro development pending confirmation; would be re-scored to 4+ on approval/drawdown).
